shortDescription: SANTA ANA, Calif., Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TTM Technologies, Inc. children: ("TTM"), a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency ("RF") components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced interconnect products, including printed circuit boards ("PCB" s) and substrates, will exhibit at the electronica India 2026 trade fair, at Hall 3, Booth B11, from September 16–18, 2026, at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre, Bangalore, India.

As the electronics industry accelerates toward smarter, faster, and more connected solutions, TTM continues to expand its capabilities and global reach to meet the growing customer demand. TTM will showcase its latest advancements in interconnect and innovative solutions at South Asia's leading electronics trade fair, bringing to market technologies that address the industry's most pressing design challenges, including high-speed PCB technology for AI and hyperscale data centers, advanced interconnect and system integration, and next-generation RF and microwave technologies. Among TTM's latest innovative solutions are its N+M asymmetric PCB technologies, which enable customers to optimize signal integrity and power delivery within a single board, delivering the performance and density that today's AI infrastructure and advanced electronics applications demand.

"Electronica has long been an important platform for TTM to connect with the global electronics community, and we are proud to bring that presence to India again. electronica India represents a tremendous opportunity to engage with the rapidly expanding electronics industry in this market. We look forward to collaborating with industry leaders and demonstrating how our advanced PCB technologies and innovative solutions can empower businesses to stay ahead in a rapidly evolving marketplace," said Laura Woods, Vice President, Corporate Sales & Sales Operations at TTM Technologies.

TTM's expert team will be at the exhibition throughout the event for conversations about emerging trends and future developments shaping the next wave of electronics innovation. To schedule a meeting with TTM at electronica India 2026, please visit:

TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency ("RF") components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced interconnect products, including PCBs and substrates. TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market. Additional information can be found at www.ttm.com
